slides.heading: Loop Conditions
slides.body: Loop Conditions is part of Indefinite Iteration. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Loop Conditions
slides.body: The loop condition controls whether repetition continues. A clear condition prevents the program from stopping too early or running forever.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: The loop condition is like a timer rule: keep playing until time is up.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Every while loop needs a condition that can eventually become False, unless you intentionally stop it with break.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Make a loop continue while steps is less than 5.
slides.hint: Use while steps < 5: and update steps inside.
